title: Bob's letter from Nixon thanking him for cooperation on the project

tellings.quote: thing the thing that was a controversy around Bob was the the fact that Bob got a letter from Nixon and said, "Thank you for your cooperation on the project we're working on."

plain: Grant Cameron, a UFO researcher, tells of a man he calls Bob, in Los Angeles in the 1970s, who caused a stir because he had a letter from President Richard Nixon. According to Cameron, the letter said, "Thank you for your cooperation on the project we're working on," and people such as the journalist Linda Howe and a researcher named Larry Bryant were part of the story. If true, it would hint that a president personally knew about a secret project Bob was part of.
